title: A drunk raccoon raised $250,000
source_title: 'Remarkable': Drunk raccoon leads to $250,000 for Hanover Animal Control
description: A raccoon was caught drunk inside a liquor store in Hanover County, Virginia. A year later a campaign in his name has raised a quarter of a million dollars for the animal control team.

beats.narration: A drunk raccoon just raised a quarter of a million dollars. Yes, really.
beats.title: A drunk raccoon raised $250,000
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: About a year ago, in Hanover County, Virginia, a raccoon was captured inside a liquor store. And he was not there to browse. He was drunk.
beats.title: Caught inside a liquor store
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Animal control had to come and collect him. Imagine that call. Hello, yes, we have a customer who refuses to leave, and he has a tail.
beats.title: Imagine that phone call
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Then the internet found out. And a whole campaign started in his name.
beats.title: Then the internet found out
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Nearly a year later, that campaign has raised two hundred and fifty thousand dollars for Hanover County Animal Control. The same team that had to deal with him.
beats.title: A quarter of a million dollars
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: So let me get this straight. I work all year, completely sober, and I get a tax bill. He has one wild night and funds a whole department.
beats.title: One wild night, one funded department
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Subscribe, and I will bring you another weird but true story tomorrow.
beats.title: New true story tomorrow
beats.speaker: host
